claims.claim_text: Boeing holds the KC-46A Tanker EMD contract plus 10 authorized LRIP lots (139 aircraft, lots 9 and 10 authorized in 2023) for a USAF program with options for 13 annual production lots totaling 179 aircraft; EMD + authorized lots approximate $27B as of 12/31/2023 — i.e., Boeing's forward narrative depends on USAF continuing to fund KC-46A procurement.

The EMD contract and authorized LRIP lots total approximately $27 billion as of December 31, 2023.
